db_path.description: Path to the database file storing OTP secrets. Default taken from otpclient.cfg if not specified.

import_enabled.description: Enable import operation from a source file.

import_file.description: File to import. Mandatory if import_enabled is true.

import_type.description: The import/export type for the database. Must be one of: andotp_plain, andotp_encrypted, aegis_plain, aegis_encrypted, authpro_plain, authpro_encrypted, twofas_plain, twofas_encrypted, freeotpplus_plain.

export_enabled.description: Enable export operation to output directory.

export_output_dir.description: The output directory for export (defaults to user's home).

show_account.description: Account name to show a token for. Mandatory if show_enabled is true and not provided via CLI.

show_issuer.description: Issuer to show a token for. Used with --show.

list_enabled.description: List all accounts and issuers for the given database.

service_mode.description: Enter GApplication service mode (use from D-Bus service files).

accounts.description: List of account objects to manage or reference in configuration contexts not purely CLI-argument driven.

accounts.items.description: An account object with name and optional issuer.
